lines.text: 要不要来点小小的恋尸癖？嗯？
lines.en: Care for a little necrophilia? Hmmm?
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译（核证证据：http://www.faqs.org/faqs/movies/brazil-faq/（Notable Quotes 逐字："Jill: Care for a little necrophilia?. . .Hmmm?"）；https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0088846/quotes/（收录该台词）；clip.cafe 专段标题"Care for a little necrophilia - Brazil"）

lines.text: 这是你丈夫的收据……这是你的收据的收据。
lines.en: This is your receipt for your husband... and this is my receipt for your receipt.
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译；剧本措辞与成片字幕略异（核证证据：http://www.faqs.org/faqs/movies/brazil-faq/（逐字："Arresting Officer: This is your receipt for your husband...and this is my receipt for your receipt."）；https://www.dailyscript.com/scripts/brazil.html（剧本逐字："OFFICIAL: That's your receipt for your husband." "OFFICIAL: Thank you. And this is my receipt for your receipt."））

lines.text: 听着，小子，我们都在一条船上。
lines.en: Listen, kid, we're all in it together.
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译；同源另核到海报句"幸福：我们都在其中"（核证证据：http://www.faqs.org/faqs/movies/brazil-faq/（Notable Quotes 逐字："Tuttle: Listen, kid, we're all in it together."；同页另录海报标语"Billboard: Happiness: We're all in it together."））
